_comment: Editable multilingual keyword list for topic-relevance filtering (analysis/scope.py, docs/analysis_layer_spec.md scope pass). Matching is a case-insensitive substring check against each item's combined text (Telegram message text; YouTube title+description, already concatenated into `text` at collection time; plus transcript text where present) -- NOT a regex, so no need to escape special characters when adding entries, just add the literal phrase as it would appear in the text. This is deliberately high-precision/lower-recall: it will miss on-topic content that doesn't use one of these exact substrings. Expand freely as sample review turns up misses -- add more scripts, more transliterations, more synonyms/hashtags per topic, or whole new topic entries. Keep every keyword lowercase (or script-appropriate; non-Latin scripts have no case) since the matcher lowercases both sides.
